mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 56 degrees under partly cloudy skies near Harriet Park. Looking ahead to the overnight hours, the temperature will settle at 48 degrees with no rain expected.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This document will serve as a long-term roadmap for city development, focusing on housing, transportation, and sustainability.
We have plenty happening, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, and Hop Haus trivia all taking place today, followed by live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee.
Regarding the weekly police report, on October 3, officers took a 19-year-old into custody for being a felon in possession of a firearm following a traffic stop for expired registration.
Today's flavor was Double Strawberry. As we are currently closed for the night, we look forward to serving you our tomorrow flavor, OREO Cookie Overload, when we open at 10 AM.
